units.rawText: Oh my, Professor~ Don't look at me like I'm about to do something to you.
units.displayText: Oh my, Professor~ Don't look at me like I'm about to do something to you.

spans.text: Oh my, Professor~ Don't look at me like I'm about to do something to you.

units.rawText: I'm just here following your orders, to talk about our very first meeting~ Here's your Florence-made special blend, give it a try!
units.displayText: I'm just here following your orders, to talk about our very first meeting~ Here's your Florence-made special blend, give it a try!

spans.text: I'm just here following your orders, to talk about our very first meeting~ Here's your Florence-made special blend, give it a try!

units.rawText: You... what weird drug have you put in this time?
units.displayText: You... what weird drug have you put in this time?

spans.text: You... what weird drug have you put in this time?

units.rawText: Come on, don't be shy. Didn't you always drink whatever I made with no hesitation before?
units.displayText: Come on, don't be shy. Didn't you always drink whatever I made with no hesitation before?

spans.text: Come on, don't be shy. Didn't you always drink whatever I made with no hesitation before?

units.rawText: Back when we first met, Professor, you carried me so gently despite my wounds and tattered clothes. Ah~ I wonder what where that Professor has gone.
units.displayText: Back when we first met, Professor, you carried me so gently despite my wounds and tattered clothes. Ah~ I wonder what where that Professor has gone.

spans.text: Back when we first met, Professor, you carried me so gently despite my wounds and tattered clothes. Ah~ I wonder what where that Professor has gone.

units.rawText: Wounds and tattered clothes you say... Although my memory is quite blurry, from the records I looked through, you were enjoying hide-and-seek with the Sanctifiers in high spirits when I found you with the Exiles.

spans.text: Wounds and tattered clothes you say... Although my memory is quite blurry, from the records I looked through, you were enjoying hide-and-seek with the Sanctifiers in high spirits when I found you with the Exiles.

units.rawText: I was very excited, yes, but the actual situation was really dire, you see. After all, I was almost out of medication and operands at that time.

units.rawText: After you saved me, I joined the Exiles... Looking back, that was such an exhilarating journey~

spans.text: After you saved me, I joined the Exiles... Looking back, that was such an exhilarating journey~

units.rawText: I remember the first building we put up was the medical department, right? What I didn't expect was lil' Persi tossing me into solitary the very next day. It's a good thing you were there to beg for my release!

units.rawText: I didn't beg. We made a promise. I thought you'd learned your lesson, but that only made you shift your prank target to me.

units.rawText: I only promised you to not prank other dolls, and you aren't a Doll, Professor! Hey, have you smelled something familiar yet?

units.rawText: Just as I try to stand, a sudden wave of paralysis takes ahold of me, and I collapse to the ground.

units.rawText: Ah~ finally, the delayed paralyzing incense is kicking in. Hehehe, I added a bit of tranquilizer and energizers, but the composition is pretty much the same as the one you took when we first met~ I can still picture you, who was struggling with all your might that day~ Ah, it was so thrilling to just look at you~
